name: stack_at_most_three
description: A hollow's road holds at most stack_max waves (3 in High Water and Tide Race since the waves truly overlap; contract-m8 §1 and §2): waves 2 and 3 called during wave 1, each on the tick its Ready lands, put three waves on the road at once, and then a present seat's Ready is refused NO_STACK; so it is during the last wave, which has no wave to call behind it. Un-Ready is always taken. SimMatch.can_stack says so beforehand, as the views ask it.

steps.msg: High Water and Tide Race hold three waves at once
two waves on the road: room for a third
three waves on the road: no fourth
each called on the tick its Ready landed
a Ready with three waves on the road is refused NO_STACK

steps.assert: scene.client(1).hollows[0].wave == 12 and scene.client(1).hollows[0].phase == 1 and scene.client(1).last_wave() == 12 and not scene.client(1).can_stack(0)
steps.msg: the last wave walks: nothing to call behind it
in the last wave Ready is refused NO_STACK, Un-Ready taken
